assertions.description: SVGTextPathElement is exposed on the global object.
A created textPath element reflects startOffset as an SVGAnimatedLength.
assertions.test: (()=>{const t=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','textPath');return t instanceof SVGTextPathElement && t.startOffset instanceof SVGAnimatedLength;})()

assertions.description: startOffset moves where the first glyph is placed along the path: two copies of the same text on the same path, one with startOffset=60, measure at least 30px apart via getStartPositionOfChar.
assertions.test: (()=>{const h=document.createElement('div');h.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;width:420px;height:260px;';h.innerHTML='<svg width="400" height="240" viewBox="0 0 400 240"><defs><path id="cf-so-path" d="M 50,150 Q 200,50 350,150"/></defs><text font-size="20"><textPath href="#cf-so-path">SIDE</textPath></text><text font-size="20"><textPath href="#cf-so-path" startOffset="60">SIDE</textPath></text></svg>';document.body.appendChild(h);try{const t=h.querySelectorAll('text');if(!t[0].getNumberOfChars()||!t[1].getNumberOfChars())return false;return Math.abs(t[1].getStartPositionOfChar(0).x-t[0].getStartPositionOfChar(0).x)>30;}finally{h.remove();}})()

assertions.description: side="right" set on a textPath round-trips through getAttribute. NOTE: this proves only that the DOM stores the attribute (any unknown attribute would too) — it is deliberately NOT evidence of rendering support, which the two geometric assertions below measure.
left is the initial value of side: a textPath with no side attribute renders its first glyph at the same position as an identical one with side="left" (within 1px).
assertions.test: (()=>{const h=document.createElement('div');h.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;width:420px;height:260px;';h.innerHTML='<svg width="400" height="240" viewBox="0 0 400 240"><defs><path id="cf-dl-path" d="M 50,150 Q 200,50 350,150"/></defs><text font-size="20"><textPath href="#cf-dl-path">SIDE</textPath></text><text font-size="20"><textPath href="#cf-dl-path" side="left">SIDE</textPath></text></svg>';document.body.appendChild(h);try{const t=h.querySelectorAll('text');if(!t[0].getNumberOfChars()||!t[1].getNumberOfChars())return false;const a=t[0].getStartPositionOfChar(0),b=t[1].getStartPositionOfChar(0);return Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)<1;}finally{h.remove();}})()

assertions.description: side="right" is equivalent to reversing the path: on an open curve running from x=50 to x=350, the side="right" copy's first glyph must start more than 100px further right than the default copy's (it starts from the far end), measured with getStartPositionOfChar.
assertions.test: (()=>{const h=document.createElement('div');h.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;width:420px;height:260px;';h.innerHTML='<svg width="400" height="240" viewBox="0 0 400 240"><defs><path id="cf-sr-path" d="M 50,150 Q 200,50 350,150"/></defs><text font-size="20"><textPath href="#cf-sr-path">SIDE</textPath></text><text font-size="20"><textPath href="#cf-sr-path" side="right">SIDE</textPath></text></svg>';document.body.appendChild(h);try{const t=h.querySelectorAll('text');if(!t[0].getNumberOfChars()||!t[1].getNumberOfChars())return false;return t[1].getStartPositionOfChar(0).x-t[0].getStartPositionOfChar(0).x>100;}finally{h.remove();}})()

assertions.description: On a clockwise circular path (radius 80), the default side places glyph bodies outside the circle and side="right" places them inside: the first glyph's extent centre must measure closer to the circle centre than the default copy's by more than 5px, and inside the radius.
assertions.test: (()=>{const h=document.createElement('div');h.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:0;width:420px;height:260px;';h.innerHTML='<svg width="400" height="240" viewBox="0 0 400 240"><defs><path id="cf-cc-path" d="M 280,120 A 80,80 0 0,1 120,120 A 80,80 0 0,1 280,120"/></defs><text font-size="20"><textPath href="#cf-cc-path">ROUND</textPath></text><text font-size="20"><textPath href="#cf-cc-path" side="right">ROUND</textPath></text></svg>';document.body.appendChild(h);try{const t=h.querySelectorAll('text');if(!t[0].getNumberOfChars()||!t[1].getNumberOfChars())return false;const d=(el)=>{const e=el.getExtentOfChar(0);return Math.hypot(e.x+e.width/2-200,e.y+e.height/2-120);};const dl=d(t[0]),dr=d(t[1]);return dl>80&&dr<80&&dl-dr>5;}finally{h.remove();}})()
